title: Broken Retaining Wall
description: A thick limestone retaining wall with a central collapse, fractured ashlar, exposed rubble core and a debris fan.

review.notes: Round 2, checked against the round-1 points. Fixed: the top courses are broken and tilted, the left remnant is no longer a stepped pyramid, and the cube-grid infill is gone; the collapse fan is good (hero, closeup_base). Still failing: every block is a clean, sharp-edged white box or a faceted wedge with straight chamfers, so the broken upper courses read as cut ice or low-poly gems, not fractured limestone (closeup_upper); some faces carry a small hammered dimple pattern. There is no visible mortar or rubble core, and the colour is one even white with only light grey smudges. Fix: fracture faces with a few large planes plus secondary chips and rounded weathered arrises on the exposed tops; darker mortar in the joints with a rubble core visible at the breaks; local grime and lichen at the foot, on the weather side and on the top courses; remove the dimple pattern.
